Payload 4 support and file previews in the edit view.

```bash
pnpm add @seshuk/payload-plugin-media-preview@beta
```

## Breaking changes

- Payload 4 and Node.js 24.15+ are required. Payload 3 users stay on `1.x`.
- The edit view preview button and its `Field` component are removed. The edit view now uses Payload's `upload.admin.components.filePreview`.
- `mediaPreviewField()` only adds the list view column. `mode`, `contentMode` and `field` apply to the list cell only.
- PDF and text files no longer use the Google viewer. PDF uses the browser viewer, and the plugin renders text itself.
- External viewers (Microsoft, Google) are off by default. Set `externalViewer` to turn them on.
- `contentMode: { document: 'newTab' }` opens the file URL, not an external viewer.
- Removed exports: `MediaPreview` from `/rsc` and `MediaPreviewFieldClient` from `/client`. `/rsc` now exports `MediaPreviewFile`.
- Styles are plain CSS on the Payload 4 design tokens instead of SCSS.
- Run `payload generate:importmap` after you upgrade.
